briefs.title: Oven Mouth — Baker From Behind
briefs.prompt: Medium distance, eye level, the baker placed on the right vertical third with back fully to us, bending toward a brick oven mouth low right; face never shown, hands simplified around a long wooden peel. Flour handprints on the seat of a heavy canvas apron, one strap slipped. The oven glow is the only warm source besides a high slit window upper left through which a deep predawn ultramarine sky shows; the window light rakes across bare wooden shelves standing empty at the left, one shelf holding a single forgotten roll and a scatter of crumbs. A copper pot hangs edge-cut at the top right. Terracotta floor with a cracked tile and dropped salt. Accent pigment reserved for a folded cloth on the peel. Upper-left third stays open wall and sky. Neoclassical oil painting in the manner of Jacques-Louis David and Ingres: smooth glazed brushwork, warm ochre and umber flesh tones, deep ultramarine sky, gilded details, dramatic chiaroscuro from the upper left, faint canvas texture and craquelure. One accent pigment close to #b45309 used sparingly on drapery or a single object. Figures, if any, are painted, never photographic; shown at medium distance with faces turned three-quarter or away and hands simplified. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
briefs.negative: visible face, frontal pose, photographic skin, detailed realistic fingers, close-up portrait, centred figure, stainless steel appliances, fluorescent light, shelves fully stocked, text, lettering, signs, logos, watermarks, frame, border, cartoon or anime styling, 3D render

tells: render-look: smooth vector-like surfaces and flat wall/floor read as digital illustration, not oil
impossible detail: orange cloth hangs from the middle of the peel shaft with no reason, and the peel appears to pass through/behind the torso ambiguously
flawless too-perfect surfaces: stamped, razor-sharp flour handprints, pristine terracotta floor
uniform lighting with no shadow anchor: feet float, oven glow barely affects the figure
generic stock composition: props laid out like a diorama (window, shelf, oven) with no depth overlap
style drift: gilded frame edges visible left and right — it's a 'photo of a painting' mockup, not a hero image
melted detail: turned face is a smeared, featureless blob; oven door arch merges into the hood
flawless too-perfect surfaces: crisp stamped handprints, wax-smooth apron
generic stock composition: figure dead-centre-right with shelving as a flat backdrop
little room for a headline: dark wall band is cramped between window and shelves
text-like scribble: fake signature bottom-right
impossible detail: baker grips a short stub that does not connect to the peel actually sitting in the oven
oversaturation: oven fire blown to pure orange with no falloff
generic stock composition: too many props (jug, crate, bucket, cloth, shelf) filling every corner
subject too large/no headline room: figure and clutter leave only a small mid-wall patch for copy
flawless too-perfect surfaces: multiple identical crisp handprints on the apron
duplicated/ambiguous detail: cluster of leaning poles behind the baker reads as unexplained repeated shapes
melted detail: trouser hems and boots dissolve into vague dark masses
subject cropped: copper pot chopped at top edge
uniform lighting with weak shadow anchor: feet sit on the floor with almost no cast shadow despite strong oven glow
melted detail: left hand on the peel and the boots are indistinct smears
impossible detail: peel passes behind the torso yet reappears at the oven at an angle that doesn't quite line up
flawless surface: empty wall is uniformly rendered, no plaster damage or age
